verses.text: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered,
“Should a wise man answer with vain knowledge, and fill himself with the east wind?
lines: “Should a wise man answer with vain knowledge,
and fill himself with the east wind?

verses.text: Should he reason with unprofitable talk, or with speeches with which he can do no good?
lines: Should he reason with unprofitable talk,
or with speeches with which he can do no good?

verses.text: Yes, you do away with fear, and hinder devotion before God.
lines: Yes, you do away with fear,
and hinder devotion before God.

verses.text: For your iniquity teaches your mouth, and you choose the language of the crafty.
lines: For your iniquity teaches your mouth,
and you choose the language of the crafty.

verses.text: Your own mouth condemns you, and not I. Yes, your own lips testify against you.
lines: Your own mouth condemns you, and not I.
Yes, your own lips testify against you.

verses.text: “Are you the first man who was born? Or were you brought out before the hills?
lines: “Are you the first man who was born?
Or were you brought out before the hills?

verses.text: Have you heard the secret counsel of God? Do you limit wisdom to yourself?
lines: Have you heard the secret counsel of God?
Do you limit wisdom to yourself?

verses.text: What do you know that we don’t know? What do you understand which is not in us?
lines: What do you know that we don’t know?
What do you understand which is not in us?

verses.text: With us are both the gray-headed and the very aged men, much elder than your father.
lines: With us are both the gray-headed and the very aged men,
much elder than your father.

verses.text: Are the consolations of God too small for you, even the word that is gentle toward you?
lines: Are the consolations of God too small for you,
even the word that is gentle toward you?

verses.text: Why does your heart carry you away? Why do your eyes flash,
lines: Why does your heart carry you away?
Why do your eyes flash,

verses.text: That you turn your spirit against God, and let such words go out of your mouth?
lines: That you turn your spirit against God,
and let such words go out of your mouth?

verses.text: What is man, that he should be clean? What is he who is born of a woman, that he should be righteous?
lines: What is man, that he should be clean?
What is he who is born of a woman, that he should be righteous?

verses.text: Behold, he puts no trust in his holy ones. Yes, the heavens are not clean in his sight;
lines: Behold, he puts no trust in his holy ones.
Yes, the heavens are not clean in his sight;

verses.text: how much less one who is abominable and corrupt, a man who drinks iniquity like water!
lines: how much less one who is abominable and corrupt,
a man who drinks iniquity like water!

verses.text: “I will show you, listen to me; that which I have seen I will declare
lines: “I will show you, listen to me;
that which I have seen I will declare

verses.text: (which wise men have told by their fathers, and have not hidden it;
lines: (which wise men have told by their fathers,
and have not hidden it;

verses.text: to whom alone the land was given, and no stranger passed among them):
lines: to whom alone the land was given,
and no stranger passed among them):

verses.text: the wicked man writhes in pain all his days, even the number of years that are laid up for the oppressor.
lines: the wicked man writhes in pain all his days,
even the number of years that are laid up for the oppressor.

verses.text: A sound of terrors is in his ears. In prosperity the destroyer will come on him.
lines: A sound of terrors is in his ears.
In prosperity the destroyer will come on him.

verses.text: He doesn’t believe that he will return out of darkness. He is waited for by the sword.
lines: He doesn’t believe that he will return out of darkness.
He is waited for by the sword.

verses.text: He wanders abroad for bread, saying, ‘Where is it?’ He knows that the day of darkness is ready at his hand.
lines: He wanders abroad for bread, saying, ‘Where is it?’
He knows that the day of darkness is ready at his hand.

verses.text: Distress and anguish make him afraid. They prevail against him, as a king ready to the battle.
lines: Distress and anguish make him afraid.
They prevail against him, as a king ready to the battle.

verses.text: Because he has stretched out his hand against God, and behaves himself proudly against the Almighty,
lines: Because he has stretched out his hand against God,
and behaves himself proudly against the Almighty,

verses.text: he runs at him with a stiff neck, with the thick shields of his bucklers,
lines: he runs at him with a stiff neck,
with the thick shields of his bucklers,

verses.text: because he has covered his face with his fatness, and gathered fat on his thighs.
lines: because he has covered his face with his fatness,
and gathered fat on his thighs.

verses.text: He has lived in desolate cities, in houses which no one inhabited, which were ready to become heaps.
lines: He has lived in desolate cities,
in houses which no one inhabited,
which were ready to become heaps.

verses.text: He will not be rich, neither will his substance continue, neither will their possessions be extended on the earth.
lines: He will not be rich, neither will his substance continue,
neither will their possessions be extended on the earth.

verses.text: He will not depart out of darkness. The flame will dry up his branches. He will go away by the breath of God’s mouth.
lines: He will not depart out of darkness.
The flame will dry up his branches.
He will go away by the breath of God’s mouth.

verses.text: Let him not trust in emptiness, deceiving himself; for emptiness will be his reward.
lines: Let him not trust in emptiness, deceiving himself;
for emptiness will be his reward.

verses.text: It will be accomplished before his time. His branch will not be green.
lines: It will be accomplished before his time.
His branch will not be green.

verses.text: He will shake off his unripe grape as the vine, and will cast off his flower as the olive tree.
lines: He will shake off his unripe grape as the vine,
and will cast off his flower as the olive tree.

verses.text: For the company of the godless will be barren, and fire will consume the tents of bribery.
lines: For the company of the godless will be barren,
and fire will consume the tents of bribery.

verses.text: They conceive mischief, and produce iniquity. Their heart prepares deceit.”
lines: They conceive mischief, and produce iniquity.
Their heart prepares deceit.”
